text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spotted the performers of the commemorative live
gathered and practicing on the outdoor stage.
Lively, cheerful voices drifted over.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Let's all give it our best!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, McQueen, you're next!
Connect the choreo from Spe-chan's pose!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on, that's far too fast!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No, no! If you stop to think,
you won't train your improvisation reflexes!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, a bit late to ask, but...
Is improvisation reflex training really necessary?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Doing this gets us mentally prepared, right?
I mean, someone's bound to throw in ad-libs
during the MC or even mid-song without caring, wouldn't you say...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed, you have a point there...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
She's talkin' to you, McQueen!
Make sure ya hold back during the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me?!
She is obviously talking about you!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Improvisation requires instantaneous mental processing.
Hence, this is practice to take the dance and dialogue of the person before you,
and immediately formulate the next step.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Taking Special Week's 'Let's give it our best' line and pose,
one could, for instance... connect it to choreography
carrying the impression of 'With a smile'.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Since this is practice for reflexes,
even if it looks a bit weird, the key is to keep it going!
Alright, let's go again!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right, Hayahide, bring it oooon!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ——From here on, I shall be serious.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Th-That is not it?!
I was merely aiming for the so-called 'neck pain' pose,
by no means is my head too heavy...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin, smile, smile!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Tch... I'm still keeping it going.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Behold! Witness the secret art of Golshi-style——

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: A full-power, all-out BREAK TIME!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
..................
...That was far more mundane than I anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oi! Don't make it feel like my joke fell flat!
That was a high-level technique deliberately aiming off-angle from expectations, ya hear?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... Suzuka!
I leave the rest to you! Redeem this flag for me!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah... um, err...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: S... Strawberry daifuku!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um... I thought tea snacks went well with a break.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! You're supposed to connect the dance, the dance!
Why did this turn into a comedy improv bit?
Was that a counter-punchline? Ahahahah!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Splendid!! Great job, Suzuka!
You panicking was super cute too! You pass!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
F... Fufufu!
Thank you, Ticket-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Today's practice was so much fun~!
I ended up laughing so much!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, it really was. With everyone's ideas,
we created dances nobody could have ever expected.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The commemorative live...
I feel like it's gonna be an unimaginably amazing stage!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! With this lineup...
it's going to be a live full of unpredictable moments.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Is that why... I feel so excited——
